options.title: How Deep Is Hampstead Station?
options.first_line: Hampstead is the deepest station on the London Underground. So how far down is it?
options.first_frame: Hampstead station's red-tiled front on a rainy hill street, a red bus passing, its name on the front, the depth meter at zero.

options.title: What's Under Hampstead?
options.first_line: Under Hampstead's little station, the trains run deeper than anywhere else in London. How deep?
options.first_frame: The small station on a wet London street, cut away just below the pavement to show a lift shaft starting down, the meter at zero.

options.title: How Deep Does London's Deepest Station Go?
options.first_line: London's deepest Tube station has no escalators at all. What's under Hampstead?
options.first_frame: Hampstead station's front in the rain, lift doors visible through the entrance, the camera beginning to tip down, the meter at zero.

why: It opens on a surprise you can picture (London's deepest Tube station has no escalators) and holds the depth back, so you stay to learn how far down the lifts go and why.
